PDF.js (pdfjs-dist) 4.10.38, Apache-2.0.
Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/pdfjs-dist/v/4.10.38
Vendored legacy browser modules, worker, CMaps and standard fonts.
All resources are served locally; selected document content is never sent to a CDN.
Dynamic evaluation is disabled via isEvalSupported:false. The application does
not execute embedded PDF document scripts.
